From: Daphne Wallace aill=M>

Subject: Mail correspondence - May 14, 2018
Date: Mon, 14 May 2018 20:45:15 +0000
Attachments: N-445, Notice_of Naturalization_Oath_Ceremony_-_May_11, 2018_Received_at_STC_May_14,_2018.pdf

Greetings Karyna,
Your Notice of Naturalization Oath Ceremony arrived in the mail this afternoon.
The ceremony will take place on Wednesday, May 30, 2018 at 8 am on the Third Floor of the Federal Building of
the US District Court.
There is a questionnaire on the reverse side that must be completed and brought with you to the ceremony, along
with the documents listed on the front of the notice.
Would you like me to Fedex the original document to you now, or secure it in my office until you return?
Kind regards and Congratulations again, Daphne

EFTA00542942
